run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T18:27:09Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: frontend's RequestErrorRate alert is explained by one broken route: the frontend's GET /api/data requests fail because its gRPC dependency oteldemo.AdService/GetAds fails, because the only `ad` pod was removed at 18:26:07Z and its ReplicaSet could never create a replacement — every create attempt was rejected by the newly created ResourceQuota `otel-demo-memory` (hard 1.4Gi vs used 1901Mi). ad has had no pod and the `ad` Service has had no endpoints since then, ad's span activity decayed to zero, frontend's AdService/GetAds client spans became 100% error, GET /api/data became 100% error, and frontend-proxy ingress/egress spans began erroring. Cart and product-catalog-backed routes stayed clean, so this is dependency-specific, not a frontend-wide outage. The exact alert expression and the trigger for the ad pod's removal are not verifiable with the available integrations.

claims.text: At 18:27:09Z the frontend service had STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans at 0.5/s against 52.89/s STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and the first non-zero frontend error rate appears in the 18:26–18:28Z interval (0.3556/s at 18:28:00Z, rising to 0.86/s by 18:39Z), i.e. the alert's firing time coincides with the first observed errors.

The frontend errors are concentrated on one route chain: at 18:39:00Z span `GET /api/data` had 0.2134/s STATUS_CODE_ERROR and 0/s STATUS_CODE_UNSET (all such spans failing), span `grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds` had 0.2134/s STATUS_CODE_ERROR, and `GET` (page) had 0.2134/s error against 1.8493/s unset; `tcp.connect` error rate was only 0.0259/s at 18:27:09Z and 0.0079/s at 18:39:00Z.
At 18:35:00Z the frontend's client span `grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds` was 0.8519/s STATUS_CODE_ERROR with 0/s STATUS_CODE_UNSET, i.e. every observed ad call failed.

The `ad` service stopped producing spans: its server span `oteldemo.AdService/GetAds` ran at 1.126/s at 18:27:09Z, decayed to 0.796/s at 18:28:09Z and 0.3556/s at 18:30:09Z and 0 from 18:32:09Z onward, with `getAdsByCategory`, `getRandomAds` and the flagd EventStream spans likewise zero; at 18:39:00Z the `ad` service reported no traffic at all.

Deployment `otel-demo/ad` has spec.replicas=1 with unavailableReplicas=1, readyReplicas and availableReplicas absent, condition Available=False reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable at 18:26:17Z, and ReplicaFailure=True stating: pods "ad-554b849958-v9dqt" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m.
ReplicaSet `ad-554b849958` (owner Deployment `ad`, created 17:55:40Z) is at replicas=0 with a ReplicaFailure condition carrying the same quota rejection message.

Events show the ad pod being removed by its own Deployment controller and then blocked: 18:26:07Z Deployment `ad` "Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0" together with Killing "Stopping container ad" on pod `ad-554b849958-p226w` and ReplicaSet SuccessfulDelete; 18:26:17Z "Scaled up replica set ad-554b849958 from 0 to 1"; then repeated Warning FailedCreate events for pods ad-554b849958-v9dqt/jk89r/768hf/7vlzz/j97lq/kvbrg/hzxxc/rm569/pwfxk between 18:26:17Z and 18:26:18Z and a combined event with count 8 at 18:31:45Z, all with the same quota message.

ResourceQuota `otel-demo-memory` in namespace otel-demo was created at 2026-11-16T18:25:57Z — 10 seconds before the ad ReplicaSet was scaled down and 20 seconds before the first FailedCreate — with status.hard memory=1503238553600m (=1.4Gi) and status.used memory=1901Mi.

The 20 running otel-demo pods' memory requests sum to 1901Mi (largest: kafka 300Mi, flagd 120Mi+250Mi, fraud-detection 200Mi, accounting 160Mi, otel-collector 150Mi, checkout 128Mi), which equals the quota's reported used value and exceeds the 1.4Gi hard limit before the ad pod's 225Mi request is even added.

No `ad` pod exists: the otel-demo pod list contains 20 pods (accounting, cart, checkout, currency, email, flagd, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart), none of them `ad`, and a cluster-wide pod name filter for "ad" returned no ad pod in any namespace.
Service `ad` in otel-demo (selector opentelemetry.io/name=ad, port 8080) has an empty endpoints object — no subsets, no addresses, no ports.

Before the outage, sampled traces at 18:25:24–18:25:25Z show the visible parent chain frontend `GET` → `GET /api/data` → `executing api route (pages) /api/data` → frontend client span `grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds` → `ad` span `oteldemo.AdService/GetAds` → `getAdsByCategory`, all with http.status_code 200 or rpc.grpc.status_code 0.
frontend-proxy reports its own error spans at 18:39:00Z: span `ingress` 0.2568/s STATUS_CODE_ERROR vs 2.6395/s unset, and span `router frontend egress` 0.2489/s error vs 2.6514/s unset.

Other frontend routes and their dependencies stayed clean at 18:39:00Z: `GET /api/cart` 0.2055/s unset with 0 error, `GET /api/products/{productId}` 1.1696/s unset with no error series, and service-level error rates of 0 for recommendation, payment, accounting and fraud-detection — so the frontend was not failing wholesale and the blast radius is the ad-dependent route.

The frontend pod itself shows no restart-type failure: frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 is Running and ready with restartCount 0 and startTime 2026-11-16T17:55:42Z, and all other otel-demo pods are likewise Running/ready with 0 restarts.

Image pull failure, unschedulability or node eviction/OOMKill as the reason ad has no pod is rejected: the exact admission message is a ResourceQuota rejection ("is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory"), and the pod was removed by its own Deployment controller (Killing "Stopping container ad", ReplicaSet SuccessfulDelete, Deployment ScalingReplicaSet 1→0), with no Evicted event.

Primary causal chain for the alert: ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory (created 18:25:57Z, hard 1.4Gi, used 1901Mi) blocked recreation of the removed ad pod from 18:26:17Z onward → ad Service has no endpoints → frontend client spans grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds fail at 100% → frontend `GET /api/data` fails at 100% → frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans (alert RequestErrorRate) and frontend-proxy ingress/egress error spans. The timing (pod loss 18:26:07Z, first errors in the 18:26–18:28Z bucket) and the route/dependency specificity support this, but no post-18:25 trace or log evidence shows the actual gRPC status code returned to frontend.

Remaining candidate cause that is not resolved: the frontend-proxy `ingress` and `router frontend egress` errors may be separate proxy-side connection failures rather than the ad-induced frontend 5xx responses; only 0.25/s of its spans error, and no trace or log in this Run covers a failing proxy request after 18:25:25Z, so this cannot be attributed.

The low-rate frontend `tcp.connect` error spans (0.0778/s at 18:28:00Z, 0.0222/s sporadically afterwards) are consistent with connection attempts to the endpoint-less ad Service, but the peer of those spans is not visible in the evidence, so attribution to ad remains unproven.

Advisory for humans: bring namespace memory requests back under the enforced quota (either raise ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory's hard memory above the ~2126Mi total needed with ad, or lower the existing requests, e.g. kafka 300Mi, flagd 370Mi, fraud-detection 200Mi) so ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 can create its 225Mi pod; the alert at frontend should then clear once ad's endpoints are populated.

gaps: The alerting rule `RequestErrorRate` is not loaded in the queried Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules filtered by that rule name returned no rules, so the alert's exact expression and how the annotation value 5.088888888888889 is computed (unit/denominator/window) are unknown; this Run could not verify that value arithmetically.

Jaeger's newest traces end at 2026-11-16T18:25:25Z, before the 18:26:07Z pod loss and before any error span; queries for frontend traces in 18:28–18:42Z and tag searches tags='error=true' and http.status_code="500" returned no data, so the status code and error detail of the failing AdService/GetAds and GET /api/data spans are unknown.

frontend pod logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 over 18:00:00–18:42:59Z returned 0 lines / 0 bytes (no previous container instance), so no application log evidence exists for the failing route in this Run.

Metrics kube_deployment_status_replicas_available and kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready for deployment `ad` returned no series, so the replica-count history could not be charted; the replica state is only known from the deployment/ReplicaSet objects observed after the fact.

The change_history integration is not integrated, so what (or who) created ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory at 18:25:57Z and what caused Deployment `ad` to scale its ReplicaSet 1→0 at 18:26:07Z and back could not be verified; those two changes are facts, but their common trigger and ordering are unverified.

Services checkout, currency, shipping, email, quote, image-provider, kafka and load-generator returned no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series, which is unknown rather than zero; they were not otherwise checked for their own error or latency signals.
No latency baseline was compared, so no latency regression is claimed for frontend or ad.
next_steps: Review the ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory change at 18:25:57Z (hard memory 1.4Gi) against the namespace's ~1901Mi of pod memory requests, and decide whether to raise the quota or reduce requests before any further rollout.
Inspect who/what scaled Deployment `ad` to zero and back at 18:26:07–18:26:17Z, since that rollout is what exposed the quota block (change history is not available here).

Once ad has a running pod, re-check frontend GET /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error rates and the frontend-proxy ingress error rate to confirm the alert clears and to close the proxy-error question.
